handoffs.task_title: Answer the frustrated-greeter vs fear question by watching him on two walks
handoffs.evidence: Toward + high-pitched + forward + fine on meeting = FRUSTRATED GREETER (good news, very trainable, impulse control).

handoffs.task_title: Measure and write down his threshold distance
handoffs.evidence: Method: when you see a dog far off, stop. Offer a treat. If he takes it and can look at you, you're under threshold — note roughly how far (count parked cars, driveways, or sidewalk squares).
